'''Nen''' was the only [[Star/Legends|sun]] of the [[Neimoidia system/Legends|Neimoidia system]].<ref name="TEA" /> An aging star, Nen was not very generous toward the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] it shone upon. Among other reasons, the lack of sunshine made the world of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] a place to be avoided, even by its native [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]].<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
